top_signal.title: UPDATE Would You Sell to this Buyer? Help!!
top_signal.summary: Update! I was ready to proceed with the sale, and then I received this email and without much shipping experience, I have no idea if this is a legitimate thing or not:   I am on the checkout page and about to fill out the address to send to. Please let me know what carrier you are using as it determines how I make out my address. If using USPS I will need to provide a different address than if you use Fedex or UPS. It’s weird I know. It’s just that I send all my mail to my post office.. USPS does not want a street address and so you won’t be able to ship it out.    So if you would please let me know asap so I can fill out your shipping form properly and then I can finish up checking out. . Thanks!   THEN as I was making this update, she purchased it using the address of the post office (which I confirmed) and sent me this follow up:   Hi, I went ahead and checked out using my full address. Just so you are aware, if you use USPS do not use the my post office’s street address. The system will reject this. So here is how to address it if using USPS   (Address with post office street address)   If using Fedex of UPS address it as follows:   (Address without the post office street address)   She paid through Paypal, addresses match, she's a verified buyer, and seller protection is enabled.
